meta.name: apollo-prod-checklist
meta.description:
Execute Apollo.io production deployment checklist.
Use when preparing to deploy Apollo integrations to production,
doing pre-launch verification, or auditing production readiness.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo production checklist", "deploy apollo",
"apollo go-live", "apollo production ready", "apollo launch checklist".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 上线前自动核查 Apollo 集成部署，确保生产就绪
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果准备将 Apollo 集成发布到生产环境
copy.tagline_en: Run Apollo integration deployment checks before go-live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're preparing to ship Apollo integrations to production

howto.what: 当用户要求执行 Apollo 生产部署检查时，Claude 会按清单逐项核验准备情况，产出部署前检查结果、验证脚本结果、部署后验证结果和回滚程序文档。
howto.when: 在准备将 Apollo 集成部署到生产环境、做上线前验证或审计生产就绪时，说出“apollo production checklist”“deploy apollo”等短语即可触发。

say.text: 跑一遍 apollo 生产部署检查清单。
say.note: Claude 会启动检查流程并输出各项结果。

say.text: 我要把 Apollo 集成上线，先做生产就绪检查。
say.note: Claude 会核对前置条件并执行检查。

say.text: 执行 apollo go-live 检查。
say.note: Claude 会按清单验证部署状态。

howto.what_en: When asked to run the Apollo production deployment checklist, Claude walks through it, validates setup, and outputs pre-deployment results, validation script results, post-deployment verification, and rollback documentation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when preparing to deploy Apollo integrations to production, doing pre-launch verification, or auditing readiness, or when phrases like 'apollo production checklist' or 'deploy apollo' are used.

say_en.text: Run the apollo production deployment checklist.
say_en.note: Claude starts the checklist process and outputs the results.

say_en.text: I'm deploying Apollo to production; do a pre-launch check.
say_en.note: Claude verifies prerequisites and runs checks.
Claude validates deployment readiness step by step.
